profile.summary: Human Resources executive with 15+ years of progressive experience transforming HR from administrative function to strategic business partner. Demonstrates expertise in full-spectrum HR operations including recruitment, compensation and benefits administration, performance management, employee relations, and regulatory compliance. Proven track record leading HR teams, implementing organizational development initiatives, and aligning HR strategies with business objectives across manufacturing and industrial sectors. Strong background in labor law compliance, training and development program design, and managing complex disciplinary and grievance matters.
